article.title: Notes on Ogunian Anarchism: A Meditation for Hoodoo Heritage Month
article.author: Zuri arman
article.content: Sparked by D’Angelo’s grounding excursion to South Carolina—where my people’re from—and recorded partly in Cuba—the homeland of Lukumí—Voodoo was my introduction to the rapturous possibilities of Ogunian anarchism before I had the language to describe it. Read more via Scalawag : Notes on Ogunian Anarchism: A Meditation for Hoodoo Heritage Month .
